fixture.fold_rule: sha256(query) first hex digit even -> cal, odd -> conf (pre-registered, BEP-1); hold-out B items carry fold "holdout"

ac_fixture.note: AC-2-4/AC-2-5 fixture (Phase 1); equals the union of the gated strata and hold-out B

metric_definitions.recall_at_5: expected lesson in the union of lesson_slugs of the top 5 survivors (BEP-1 definition, generalised)
metric_definitions.recall_at_5_slot_equal: expected lesson among the first 5 (span, lesson) pairs, lessons expanded in blueprint order (informational)
metric_definitions.answer_rate: share of in-domain queries with >= 1 document span among the top 4 survivors (all-approved configuration)

configurations.name: governed_as_configured
configurations.description: committed manifest, D-31: zero approved; authored spans only

configurations.name: all_public_approved
configurations.description: every public-plane bound item approved (temporary manifest, never committed)

selection.rule: feasible on the cal fold (no oos_general/stop_only result; recall >= legacy) and on the learner questions; floor = midpoint of the intersection, rounded down to 0.05; margin = upper end - floor, rounded down to 0.05

stress_probes.note: informational; each off-topic AC-fixture question plus a course phrase

fragility: all_public_approved learner_questions slot-equal recall_at_5 27 < legacy 28 (informational metric)
limitations: coverage-v1 and the framing stopwords (define, definition, term, terms, word, words) were designed after inspecting leaks on the whole repository fixture, including the conf fold and hold-out B; AC-2-4 on it is design-set evidence
near_miss and oos_lexical were not used in design; see reported_strata_vs_p1 for bm25f-v1 against the Phase 1 floor
learner questions appear verbatim in authored spans (circular for the governed configuration)
the Phase 0 answer rate is a proxy measured at b3d6808c before the floor
